definitions.explanation: Thick, stiff paper used for crafts, packaging, backing for documents, and similar purposes. Thicker than regular paper but not as heavy as corrugated cardboard.

examples.japanese: {厚紙|あつがみ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I make a box out of cardboard.

examples.japanese: ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{厚紙|あつがみ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{挟|はさ}んで→挟む：00091_hasamu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: When mailing photos, please sandwich them between pieces of cardboard.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{厚紙|あつがみ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ハサミ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{工作|こうさく}→工作：12437_kousaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The children are doing crafts with cardboard and scissors.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{厚|あつ}い→厚い：00690_atsui⟧ (thick) + ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧ (paper). Refers to stiff paper stock, not corrugated cardboard (which is ⟦{段|だん}ボール→段ボール：18885_danbooru⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {厚紙|あつがみ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ — to make from cardboard
- {厚紙|あつがみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ — to cut cardboard
- {厚紙|あつがみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{印刷|いんさつ}する→印刷する：21677_insatsusuru⟧ — to print on cardstock

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{段|だん}ボール→段ボール：18885_danbooru⟧ — corrugated cardboard (heavier, used for shipping boxes)
- ⟦{画用紙|がようし}→画用紙：11511_gayoushi⟧ — drawing paper (thick but for art use)
- {薄紙|うすがみ} — thin paper, tissue paper (opposite in thickness)
